الفِئَالُ A certain game of the boys (T, S, O, K,
TA) of the desert-Arabs, (TA,) with earth, or dust: (T:) they hide a thing in earth, or dust, and then divide it, and say, In which of them (S, O, K, TA) twain (S, O, TA) is it? (S, O, K, TA.) [See also الفَيَالُ, in art. فيل.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
